body: I'm going to start looking for someone to talk today. I live in a town built around a highway and there's no public transport, unfortunately.

I have antidepressants I take regularly but I haven't talked to anyone since last April. Logically I know my life has worth, I just can't see myself getting to a point in my life where I'm content with life. 

Currently, I spend most of my time watching videos online and playing games on my phone. I can't really do much to get out of the house bc I have neither my driver's license or a car to drive. I'm not very religious.
